ipu.name: IPU Parline: expected date of next elections
ipu.basis: Parliaments' own data, compiled by the IPU from national parliaments; legislative chambers only
ipu.note: Dates are usually a month, stored by the IPU as the last day of it. Covers legislative elections, not presidential ones. The expected date is whatever the parliament reported and is not always refreshed after an election is called early.

ifes.name: IFES ElectionGuide: upcoming and anticipated elections
ifes.basis: IFES staff research on national electoral management bodies; each date is marked confirmed or not confirmed
ifes.licence: Public pages, read for reference with attribution; IFES' data service needs credentials
ifes.note: Only the two public listing pages are read (no training use, no bulk crawl). Covers presidential and legislative elections.

cia.name: CIA World Factbook: chief of state and head of government (frozen snapshot)
cia.publisher: CIA World Factbook, republished by the factbook.json project
cia.basis: Compiled by the CIA from public sources; no longer updated
cia.note: The CIA has retired the Factbook, so this reading stops at its snapshot date: an office-holder who changed since then shows as a difference that is a change of office, not an error. Names are matched on surname text, so a different transliteration also shows as a difference.

unavailable.name: IPU Parline website exports (data.ipu.org downloads)
unavailable.reason: The website refuses non-browser requests (HTTP 403); the open JSON API at api.data.ipu.org is used instead.

unavailable.name: IFES ElectionGuide data service
unavailable.reason: Bulk and API access needs credentials requested from IFES; not held, so not used.

unavailable.name: CIA World Factbook, live site
unavailable.reason: The CIA retired the Factbook; the live pages now redirect to a farewell notice, so only the frozen republished snapshot exists.

unavailable.name: National electoral commission websites
unavailable.reason: About 190 separate sites in different formats and languages with no common machine-readable feed; not read. IFES' listing is the one place that summarises them.

unavailable.name: UN Protocol list of heads of state, heads of government and foreign ministers
unavailable.reason: Published only as a periodically updated PDF; no stable machine-readable link was found, so it was not read.
